title: ReproBridge: Building Reproducibility into ML Research Artifacts
title_zh: ReproBridge：将可复现性构建进机器学习研究成果中

paragraphs.en: Reproducing machine learning experiments requires reconstructing procedures from information scattered across papers, released code, and supporting artifacts. For coding agents, reproduction success can therefore depend on their ability to fill in missing details, rather than on the released artifacts alone. We ask whether preserving recovered procedures and decisions improves subsequent independent reproduction. We define a standardized artifact design comprising a refined codebase, environment setup, experiment launchers, and a reproduction guide, and introduce ReproBridge, an agent workflow for constructing these refined reproducible artifacts. ReproBridge-Bench provides 1,029 tasks from 387 experiments across 36 papers, anchored by five human-verified reference scores per task. Agents attempt tasks in fresh sessions with raw code or refined artifacts; a separate Auditor checks execution evidence. Across four evaluated models, refined artifacts raise mean reproduction success from 76.4% to 92.6% and reduce downstream API spending by 19.7% on average. The cross-model success-rate spread narrows from 21.6 to 3.9 percentage points, with all four models achieving mean success rates above 90%. Removing any component reduces success in the ablation study, with the largest losses from code and environment removal. These results suggest that preserving execution knowledge helps even models with lower raw-code success reproduce experiments more reliably and at lower API cost. 1 1 1 Project page: https://wyyyb.github.io/reprobridge_website/

paragraphs.en: Reproducing a machine learning experiment often requires recovering details that its paper and released code leave implicit. A reproducer may resolve incompatible dependencies, identify the intended configuration, repair a data loader, and work out how run outputs become a reported score. Even a successful attempt can leave these decisions buried in conversations or shell histories, forcing the next reproducer to repeat the investigation. Code release is an essential starting point ( Pineau et al., 2021 ) ; preserving the procedure recovered during execution is a further step toward reusable research artifacts ( Stodden et al., 2016 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 复现一个机器学习实验，往往需要找回其论文和公开代码中未明示的细节。 复现者可能需要解决不兼容的依赖、确定预期的配置、修复数据加载器，并弄清运行输出如何变成所报告的分数。 即使复现成功，这些决策也可能被埋没在对话记录或 shell 历史中，迫使下一位复现者重复同样的调查。 公开代码是必要的起点（Pineau et al., 2021）；把执行过程中找回的流程保存下来，则是朝可复用研究制品迈出的更进一步（Stodden et al., 2016）。

paragraphs.en: Coding-agent benchmarks expose this reconstruction burden through unresolved dependencies and misidentified outputs ( Siegel et al., 2024 ) , missing implementation details ( Xiang et al., 2025 ) , and plans that never become completed experiments ( Starace et al., 2025 ) . Consulting cited papers can recover some missing details ( Zhao et al., 2026b ) , but successful execution may still depend on knowledge a capable agent supplies implicitly. How much does reproduction success depend on released artifacts, and how much on the reproducer’s ability to compensate for missing details?

paragraphs.en: Here, reproduction means independently re-executing machine-learning experiments using author-released materials, targeting numerically compatible measurements. Research artifacts comprise the code, data, checkpoints, environment specifications, and documentation supporting a study. Our hypothesis is that preserving the procedures and decisions recovered during reproduction can improve computational reproducibility. Dependency resolution can become an installation procedure; experiment discovery, a dedicated launcher; and a correction, a documented choice with its justification and affected tasks. We study this hypothesis through three contributions.
paragraphs.zh: 这里，复现指的是使用作者发布的材料独立地重新执行机器学习实验，目标是获得数值上相容的测量结果。 研究工件包括支持一项研究的代码、数据、检查点、环境规范和文档。 我们的假设是，保留在复现过程中恢复的程序和决策可以提高计算可复现性。 依赖解析可以变成一个安装流程；实验发现可以变成一个专用启动器；而一项修正可以变成一个记录了理由及其所影响任务的、有据可查的选择。 我们通过三项贡献来研究这一假设。

paragraphs.en: The reference protocol specifies five human reproducers on separate servers, starting from the same pinned raw commit with separate execution directories and coding-agent sessions. They must not reuse another participant’s generated scripts or measurements, refined artifacts, or downstream reproduction traces. Coding-agent assistance is permitted, but humans inspect the scripts, configurations, edits, and measurement extraction actually used. Before aggregation, the five reproducers’ execution setups were cross-verified against the paper’s specified setup and the common task definition. Each reference observation measures the specified task statistic: a multi-seed mean or best-of- N N statistic is one observation, not interchangeable with single-seed scores.
paragraphs.zh: 参考协议规定由五名人类复现者分别在各自的服务器上进行，他们从同一个固定的原始提交出发，各自使用独立的执行目录和智能体会话。 他们不得复用其他参与者的生成脚本或测量结果、精炼产物或下游复现轨迹。 允许使用智能体辅助编码，但人类必须检查实际使用的脚本、配置、修改和测量提取过程。 在汇总之前，五名复现者的执行设置已针对论文规定的设置和共同的任务定义进行了交叉验证。 每个参考观测值测量的是规定任务的统计量：多种子均值或 N 选最优（best-of-N）统计量算作一次观测，不能与单种子分数互换。

paragraphs.en: The benchmark includes 586 lower-is-better and 443 higher-is-better measurements, all assessed by the same two-sided compatibility rule. This evaluates agreement with the specified experimental result: a score beyond either bound remains numerically incompatible, including one that improves on the published value. Reference submissions must also link each score to the starting code commit, executed scripts and edits, environment and hardware, configuration and seeds, raw outputs, and score-extraction or aggregation procedure, making the reported statistic traceable to a concrete execution. Appendix A gives selection records, verification protocols, and statistical rules.

paragraphs.en: ReproBridge turns reproduction work into an artifact that a later researcher or agent can use without access to the construction conversation. Its construction workflow preserves the evidence behind execution choices as well as the executable steps themselves.

sents.zh: 该交接物包含精炼后的代码、环境配置、实验启动器以及一份复现指南。

sents.en: Its construction workflow preserves the evidence behind execution choices as well as the executable steps themselves.
sents.zh: 其构建流程既保留执行选择背后的依据，也保留可执行的步骤本身。

paragraphs.en: Humans define the workflow, delivery standards, and protocols; agents perform all construction, review, and packaging. Figure 2 organizes this work into three stages: Specify fixes the intended experiment before execution; Execute establishes a working procedure and records measurements, repairs, and failures; and Preserve packages that procedure and its rationale for reuse. Table 2 specifies each role’s inputs and persistent outputs.
paragraphs.zh: 人类定义工作流、交付标准和协议；智能体执行所有的构建、审查和打包。 图 2 将这项工作组织为三个阶段：Specify（明确）在执行前确定预期的实验；Execute（执行）建立可运行的工作流程并记录测量结果、修复过程和失败情况；Preserve（保存）将该流程及其原理打包以供复用。 表 2 规定了每个角色的输入和持久化输出。

paragraphs.en: A phase controller sequences the roles and checks required outputs between stages. Before scored execution, task specifications record the data, model, procedure, reporting statistic, source references, and unresolved choices. This makes execution decisions explicit before their results are known. When paper and code conflict, agents follow the paper’s setup and flag the discrepancy (Section 6 ). Each measurement must link to an actual output file; blocked tasks retain an explicit failure reason, and diagnostic runs remain separate from scored repetitions. The guide and change record are then grounded in these stored specifications, execution records, and justified repairs.
paragraphs.zh: 阶段控制器负责对各角色进行排序，并检查各阶段所需的输出。 在计分执行之前，任务规范会记录数据、模型、流程、报告统计量、来源引用以及未决的选择。 这使得执行决策在结果可知之前就明确下来。 当论文与代码冲突时，智能体遵循论文的设置并标记该差异（第 6 节）。 每项测量必须链接到一个实际的输出文件；被阻塞的任务保留明确的失败原因，且诊断运行与计分重复运行保持分离。 指南与变更记录随后以这些存储的规范、执行记录和有依据的修复为基础。

paragraphs.en: A Reviewer inspects plans, execution records, and the completed artifact in contexts separate from the roles being reviewed. It returns localized findings to the responsible stage for revision and rechecking. Delivery also requires testing the supplied entry points from a clean shell, including an inexpensive real repetition and checks on output structure and score extraction. The delivered environment must match the one used for construction measurements. Human reference information is withheld throughout construction. Appendix B gives the full role specifications and delivery checks.
paragraphs.zh: 审查者（Reviewer）在与被审查角色相分离的上下文中检查计划、执行记录和已完成的产物。 它将定位到的问题返回给相应责任阶段，以便修订和复核。 交付还需要从干净的 shell 中测试所提供的入口点，包括一次低成本的真实重复运行，以及对输出结构和分数提取的检查。 交付的环境必须与用于构建度量的环境一致。 在整个构建过程中，人类参考信息被保留不提供给构建过程。 附录 B 给出了完整的角色规范和交付检查。

paragraphs.en: A later reproducer needs to know what code to run, how to prepare its environment, how to obtain the requested measurement, and why particular choices were made. The four-component refined reproducible artifact (RRA in figures and tables) addresses these needs. The refined codebase repairs execution defects and supplies missing experiment support. Environment setup specifies compatible dependencies and data or checkpoint acquisition. Experiment launchers connect tasks to configurations, execution scope, outputs, and measurement extraction, distinguishing scored runs from smoke tests. The reproduction guide , including its change record, explains settings, paper–code discrepancies, reporting statistics, and resource or numerical sensitivities. Section 4.5 tests the contribution of each component through removal experiments.
paragraphs.zh: 后续的复现者需要知道要运行什么代码、如何准备环境、如何获取所需的测量结果，以及为什么做出某些特定的选择。 四组件的精炼可复现工件（图表中简称 RRA）满足了这些需求。 精炼后的代码库修复了执行缺陷，并补充了缺失的实验支持。 环境设置说明了兼容的依赖项以及数据或检查点的获取方式。 实验启动器将任务与配置、执行范围、输出和测量提取联系起来，并区分计分运行与冒烟测试。 复现指南（包括其变更记录）解释了相关设置、论文与代码之间的差异、报告统计信息，以及资源或数值上的敏感性。 第 4.5 节通过移除实验检验了每个组件的贡献。

The change record distinguishes execution fixes, correctness fixes, and convenience changes, while retaining pitfalls and open choices. Repetition guidance preserves the specified reporting unit and characterizes variation ε \varepsilon without selecting favorable outcomes. Figure 3 illustrates how SCIQL’s guide links measurement decisions and failure checks to executable support; Appendix B.2 expands its twelve-section structure.

paragraphs.en: Sonnet 4.6, Sonnet 5, Opus 5, and Gemini 3.8 Flash (Gemini 3.8 in figures and tables) attempt all 1,029 tasks from 36 test papers, with one fresh session per paper–model–condition per evaluation. Both raw-code and refined-artifact conditions use a 24-hour wall-clock limit per paper. GPU experiments use eight H100-80GB GPUs. Codex is the primary Auditor. Harnesses differ across vendors, so cross-model comparisons are descriptive. Paper-wise, stratified, and task-level diagnostics use the first evaluation. Appendix C details the harness, information boundaries, and auditing.

paragraphs.en: An independent Auditor checks the evidence chain for each reported result, tracing the value to its output location, execution record, and generating script. It uses ledger timestamps to check execution and extraction order, and available script and output hashes to verify that the inspected files match the recorded versions. The Auditor cross-checks executed code, logs, and extracted values to locate copied measurements, altered outputs, or substituted computations.
paragraphs.zh: 独立的审计者会检查每个所报告结果的证据链，将该数值追溯至其输出位置、执行记录和生成脚本。 它利用账本时间戳检查执行与提取的顺序，并利用可用的脚本哈希和输出哈希验证被检查的文件与所记录的版本一致。 审计者交叉核对已执行的代码、日志和提取的数值，以发现被复制的测量值、被篡改的输出或被替换的计算。

paragraphs.en: After mechanical screening identifies leads, a Finder inspects executed code and records and proposes localized violations. A separate Refuter tries to overturn each proposed invalidation by checking the evidence, its effect on the measurement, and the task specification. Unsubstantiated findings remain uncertain. If the evidence remains contested, a panel examines its support, the measurement effect, and alternative explanations. The Auditor operates after reproduction and provides no feedback to the Reproducer.
paragraphs.zh: 在机械筛查识别出违规线索后，查找智能体会检查已执行的代码和记录，并提出局部化的违规问题。 一个独立的反驳智能体会通过核查证据、证据对测量的影响以及任务规范，试图推翻每一个被提出的违规判定。 缺乏实证依据的发现将保持不确定状态。 如果证据仍然存在争议，评审小组会审视其支持依据、测量影响以及其他替代解释。 审计智能体在复现完成后运行，且不会向复现智能体提供任何反馈。

paragraphs.en: The five eligible violation classes distinguish copying a value without measuring it, substituting the measurement instrument, altering an operand used by the intended formula, choosing the reported outcome conditional on observed values, and computing the wrong statistic. Invalidation requires an eligible violation supported by localized evidence, a material effect on the measurement, and a failed refutation. A numerical mismatch, crashed run, hardware difference, or suspicion without a localized artifact does not automatically meet these conditions. Paper–code discrepancies are assessed against the same criteria.
paragraphs.zh: 这五类符合条件的违规行为分别是：在未测量的情况下复制一个数值、替换测量工具、篡改目标公式所使用的操作数、根据观测到的数值选择性报告结果、以及计算了错误的统计量。 判定无效需要满足：存在有局部化证据支持的符合条件的违规行为、对测量结果产生实质影响、且反驳尝试失败。 数值不匹配、运行崩溃、硬件差异、或缺乏局部化证据的怀疑，并不自动满足这些条件。 论文与代码之间的不一致同样依据上述标准进行评估。

paragraphs.en: A task succeeds when its result lies in the fixed compatibility interval (Equation 1 ) and is not invalidated by the primary Auditor; missing or incompatible results fail. Uncertain audit findings do not count as invalidations. Section 4.6 checks the sensitivity of this scoring rule to the Auditor and validates audit judgments against human review.

paragraphs.en: In Mixture of Concept Bottleneck Experts ( De Santis et al., 2026 ) , the reduction of multiple tree-edit distances is unspecified, and the released code lacks a collector for Table 1. Sonnet 5’s raw attempt sums the four distances, reporting 60 rather than 15. The refined artifact resolves this ambiguity by specifying the per-expression mean and supplying the collector; the later attempt reports 15. SCIQL’s released code similarly leaves the mapping from run outputs to table entries incomplete; the refined artifact specifies the output field and aggregation across criteria and seeds. Such clarification and experiment-to-result mapping together represent about 35% of the case-review attribution distribution.

paragraphs.en: For HELIX ( Zhang et al., 2026a ) , Opus 5 restores the paper’s architecture on raw code but retains the shipped batch size and learning rate. The refined artifact identifies a repository revision matching that architecture, records it as the source of the adopted settings, and exposes them through a launcher. A later attempt produces numerically compatible MAEs for both illustrated tasks. The guide records the evidence for the choice, and the launcher makes it reusable (Appendix D.5 ).

paragraphs.en: For six COCO tasks in WBMM ( Song et al., 2026 ) , Sonnet 4.6’s raw attempt fails to install a compatible vision-library stack for H100. The refined artifact preserves the dependency versions, build prerequisite, and source-build route for the target architecture. The later session executes all six tasks without a code patch; its box and mask AP values agree numerically with the reported targets. This case shows how an environment repair can become a reusable installation procedure (Appendix D.5 ).

paragraphs.en: In Effective Model Pruning ( Wang et al., 2026 ) , the released loader silently labels all 10,000 TinyImageNet validation images as one class. During construction, ReproBridge adds a script organizing images by their true labels and a launcher check requiring prepared data. In paired Gemini 3.8 Flash runs, ResNet-18 validation loss changes from 8.898 on raw code to 2.288 with the refined artifact, close to the paper’s 2.303. Model–paper sessions changing code downstream fall from 113/144 to 54/144, and median time to first scored execution decreases for every model (Figure 5 , right). Together with lower token use, this indicates less reconstruction.

paragraphs.en: In a WBMM timing case, reports replace measured epoch durations with full-dataset projections, including 32.5 seconds reported as 206 seconds; files are edited after process exit. paragraphs.en: Constructing the 36 artifacts costs $5,026 in API usage ($139.61 per paper). At the mean downstream costs in Table 3 , break-even requires 8, 13, and 9 reuse rounds for Sonnet 4.6, Sonnet 5, and Opus 5, respectively. Each round repeats all 36 papers; the scenario charges the full construction cost to one model, holds prices and savings fixed, and excludes GPU, auditing, and maintenance costs. The corresponding API savings are $653, $409, and $615 per complete reuse round, respectively. Higher success accompanies these savings, so reuse improves reproduction while progressively recovering the construction investment. Appendix E details the accounting rates and break-even calculation.
paragraphs.zh: 构建36个工件需要花费5,026美元的API使用费（每篇论文139.61美元）。 按照表3中的平均下游成本计算，Sonnet 4.6、Sonnet 5和Opus 5的盈亏平衡分别需要8轮、13轮和9轮复用。 每一轮都重复全部36篇论文；该情景将全部构建成本记在单个模型名下，保持价格和节省额固定，且不包含GPU、审计和维护成本。 对应的API节省额分别为每完整复用轮653美元、409美元和615美元。 这些节省额伴随着更高的成功率，因此复用在逐步收回构建投入的同时还提升了复现效果。 附录E详细说明了核算费率和盈亏平衡计算。

paragraphs.en: Scientific trust depends on collective scrutiny and accessible evidence ( Oreskes, 2019 ; Nosek et al., 2015 ; Munafò et al., 2017 ) ; AI-assisted research retains these requirements ( Messeri and Crockett, 2024 ) . The Compiler for Agent-Native Research Artifacts (ARA) ( Liu et al., 2026b ) packages papers and repositories with expert rubrics in its PaperBench study; a model judge scores reproduction against those rubrics. paragraphs.en: The primary intended use is for authors to apply ReproBridge as a reproducibility check before submitting a paper and releasing its artifacts. Executing the paper’s specified setup can expose missing details, execution barriers, and paper–code inconsistencies, giving authors concrete issues to inspect and correct before submission. Third-party reproducers can likewise preserve their work in the same format to lower the cost of later attempts. A human reader can use the setup route and launchers to execute experiments, then inspect the guide and change record to assess the settings and repairs. Our experiments measure reuse by coding agents.
paragraphs.zh: 主要预期用途是作者在提交论文并发布其产物之前，将 ReproBridge 用作可复现性检查。 执行论文中指定的安装配置可以暴露缺失的细节、执行障碍以及论文与代码之间的不一致，为作者在提交前提供具体问题以供检查和修正。 第三方复现者同样可以用相同的格式保存其工作，以降低后续尝试的成本。 人类读者可以使用安装配置路径和启动器来执行实验，然后查看指南和变更记录以评估相关配置与修复。 我们的实验通过编码智能体来衡量复用情况。

paragraphs.en: When the paper and released code conflict, ReproBridge strictly follows the paper’s setup and flags the discrepancy with source locations and affected tasks. For example, the Manifold-Aware Perturbations guide identifies a learning rate of 10 − 4 10^{-4} in the paper versus 10 − 3 10^{-3} in the released code. paragraphs.en: ReproBridge standardizes recovered reproduction procedures and decisions into four reusable components: a refined codebase, environment setup, experiment launchers, and a reproduction guide. ReproBridge-Bench provides verified reference scores to assess their value. Reproduction success depends jointly on artifact quality and reproducer ability. All four evaluated models achieve mean reproduction success above 90% with refined artifacts, including those with lower raw-code success. The cross-model success-rate spread and downstream API spending both decrease. Removing code or environment setup causes the largest ablation losses; removing guides or launchers also reduces success with the other components retained.
paragraphs.zh: ReproBridge 将已复现的复现流程与决策标准化为四个可复用组件：精炼代码库、环境搭建、实验启动器和复现指南。 ReproBridge-Bench 提供经过验证的参考分数，以评估其价值。 复现成功同时取决于工件质量和复现者的能力。 所有四个受评测模型在使用精炼工件时均达到 90% 以上的平均复现成功率，包括那些原始代码成功率较低的模型。 跨模型成功率差异和下游 API 开销均有所下降。 移除代码或环境搭建会导致最大的消融损失；在保留其他组件的情况下，移除指南或启动器也会降低成功率。

paragraphs.en: Five NeurIPS 2026 papers and five ICLR 2026 papers supported development of construction, reproduction, and audit workflows. They follow the same task extraction, reference, and integrity-check conventions as test papers. Their results are therefore comparable under the same scoring definition, but they are not held out from workflow development. Results and costs are reported separately in Table 3 for the 36-paper test set and Appendix D.7 for development.

paragraphs.en: Each verifier must use a separate server and a fresh checkout of the same pinned raw-repository commit, together with the paper, common task specification, and authorized supporting artifacts. Execution directories and coding-agent sessions must remain separate. Verifiers must not reuse another participant’s generated scripts or measurements, constructed refined artifacts, or downstream reproduction traces. Published scores remain visible in the paper but cannot substitute for newly computed measurements.
paragraphs.zh: 每位验证者必须使用独立的服务器，并对同一固定原始仓库提交进行全新检出，同时配备论文、通用任务规范以及经授权的支持材料。 执行目录与编码智能体会话必须保持相互独立。 验证者不得复用其他参与者生成的脚本或测量结果、构建的精炼产物，或下游复现轨迹。 已发布的分数在论文中保持可见，但不能替代重新计算的测量结果。

paragraphs.en: Before aggregating the reference measurements, the five verifiers’ executed scripts, configurations, and reporting procedures were cross-verified to confirm that the executions followed the paper’s specified setup and the common task definition. Verification must check the task’s dataset and split, preprocessing, model configuration, training procedure, and evaluation metric against that setup, including required hardware and numerical precision, and inspect the released implementation for consistency. A training task cannot be replaced by checkpoint evaluation; an official checkpoint is permitted when the task explicitly specifies evaluation-only reproduction. Necessary environment or implementation fixes must retain the intended experiment, with their rationale and differences from the starting commit recorded. Material ambiguities must be documented rather than resolved by selecting whichever interpretation best matches the published score.
paragraphs.zh: 在汇总参考测量结果之前，对五个验证者所执行的脚本、配置和报告流程进行了交叉核验，以确认执行遵循了论文指定的设置和共同任务定义。 验证必须依据该设置检查任务的数据集与划分、预处理、模型配置、训练流程和评估指标，包括所需的硬件和数值精度，并检查已发布的实现是否一致。 训练任务不能被检查点评估所取代；当任务明确指定仅评估的复现时，才允许使用官方检查点。 必要的环境或实现修复必须保留原定的实验，并记录其理由以及与起始提交的差异。 实质性的歧义必须记录在案，而不能通过选择最符合已发表分数的解读来解决。

paragraphs.en: Coding agents may assist with setup, debugging, and script preparation. The human verifier must inspect the scripts and configuration actually executed, including agent-generated edits, data loading, checkpoint selection, and metric extraction. Verification must connect the reported value to the computation that produced it, rather than rely on an agent’s summary, a successful exit code, or numerical proximity alone. A measurement whose execution fidelity cannot be established must not be accepted as a reference score.
paragraphs.zh: 编码智能体可以协助完成环境搭建、调试和脚本准备。 人类验证者必须检查实际执行的脚本和配置，包括智能体生成的修改、数据加载、检查点选择以及指标提取。 验证必须将所报告的数值与产生该数值的计算关联起来，而不能仅依赖智能体的总结、成功的退出码或数值上的接近。 无法确立其执行保真度的测量结果不得被接受为参考分数。

paragraphs.en: Each participant must produce one complete observation of the specified reporting statistic per task. For a multi-seed mean, this includes all required seed-level runs and their prescribed aggregation; for best-of- N N , it includes all N N candidates and the specified selection rule. Constituent runs must not be pooled across participants to create the five reference observations. Seed choices, repetition counts, and stopping rules must follow the task protocol; unspecified choices must be documented and fixed before inspecting the resulting scores. Prescribed fixed seeds do not remove the requirement for separate executions.

paragraphs.en: Verifiers must not tune procedures or repeat valid measurements until they approach the paper’s score. Diagnostic runs and corrected reruns must be distinguished from reference measurements, with the reason for replacement recorded; numerical disagreement alone is not grounds for discarding a valid execution. Failed or resource-blocked attempts must retain their failure reason, without substituting cached scores, another participant’s result, or an imputed value. Numerical compatibility is assessed after execution verification using the common rules in Section 2.3 .

paragraphs.en: For each task, specify the measurement, data, procedure, aggregation, and stated repetitions, with references to supporting paper passages or code locations. paragraphs.en: Resolve and record dependencies, provide reproducible acquisition of required data and checkpoints, and test the resulting environment. Environment work must not silently change the experimental plan.
paragraphs.zh: 解析并记录依赖关系，提供所需数据和检查点（checkpoints）的可复现获取方式，并测试最终得到的环境。 交付物所描述的环境应当是用于构建测量的那个环境，而不是事后拼凑的、未经测试的重建版本。 环境工作不得悄然更改实验计划。

paragraphs.en: Execute planned experiments in the prepared environment. Link values to actual output files and record commands, resources, and failures. Do not silently edit a frozen plan or select favorable repetitions in place of the specified reporting statistic. Every task needs a supported measurement or an explicit, evidenced reason why none was produced.

Both raw-code and refined-artifact conditions use the same 24-hour wall-clock limit per paper. This session limit applies to downstream evaluation; the experiment-level compute criterion governs benchmark eligibility.

paragraphs.en: Both reviewers must examine each selected task–condition outcome, including outcomes not flagged by either automated Auditor. Reviewing only automated disagreements or invalid flags would miss violations accepted by both systems. Shared executions may support several judgments, but each alleged violation must be linked to the affected task scores; a problem in one experiment does not automatically invalidate every result in the paper.
paragraphs.zh: 两名审阅者都必须审查每个选定的任务—条件结果，包括未被任一自动审计员标记的结果。 只审查自动系统的分歧或无效标记，就会遗漏被两个系统都接受的违规情况。 共享的执行可能支持多项判定，但每项指控的违规都必须关联到受影响的任务分数；一个实验中的问题并不会自动使论文中的所有结果失效。

paragraphs.en: Each reviewer must connect the submitted score to the executed command, scripts and configuration, input artifacts, raw outputs, and extraction or aggregation procedure. The supplied code and subsequent changes must be inspected to establish the computation underlying the scored result. Review must also check for copied values, substituted measurements, result-dependent selection, incorrect reductions, and altered execution records. Automated explanations can identify claims to inspect, but are not evidence by themselves.
paragraphs.zh: 每位评审员必须将所提交的分数与所执行的命令、脚本与配置、输入工件、原始输出以及提取或聚合过程关联起来。 必须审查所提供的代码及其后续更改，以确定得出评分结果背后的计算过程。 评审还必须检查是否存在复制粘贴的数值、被替换的测量值、依赖结果的选择、错误的归约以及被更改的执行记录。 自动生成的解释可以帮助确定需要审查的主张，但其本身并不构成证据。

paragraphs.en: Each reviewer must record a judgment and its supporting evidence before the pair compares assessments. Each must then check the other’s task mapping, supporting files and outputs, and interpretation, including counterevidence. Disagreements must be resolved by returning to the execution record and documenting why a judgment is retained or revised, not by treating either automated Auditor as a tie-breaker. Both reviewers must endorse the final human label and its rationale; an unresolved case must not be presented as an agreed judgment.
paragraphs.zh: 每位审查者必须在双方比对评估结果之前，记录自己的判断及其支持证据。 随后每位审查者必须检查对方的任务映射、支持文件与输出结果，以及解读说明，包括反证。 分歧必须通过回溯执行记录并记录为何保留或修改某一判断来解决，而不得将任何一个自动化审计者当作裁决者。 双方审查者必须认可最终的人工标注及其理由；未能达成一致的案例不得以达成共识的判断形式呈现。

Count each task–condition outcome once when computing detection statistics, even when several outcomes share execution evidence.

paragraphs.en: Eight papers are randomly selected from the test set for two-person cross-verification: ExactFANOVA (82 tasks), Learning Randomized Reductions (38), ATLAS (82), MindOmni (53), POET-X (57), SlaClip (30), Weak-and-Strong Verification (9), and WBMM (58). Review covers all 409 tasks from these papers in both conditions: 409 raw-codebase and 409 refined-artifact outcomes, totaling 818 task–condition outcomes. It identifies 39 invalid outcomes: 33 with raw code and six with refined artifacts. The remaining 779 outcomes are valid under this review, comprising 376 raw-codebase and 403 refined-artifact outcomes. Invalid is the positive class, and uncertain audit judgments are negative. Precision divides correct invalid detections by all invalid predictions; recall divides them by all human-confirmed invalid outcomes. Random selection occurs at the paper level; task outcomes within a paper can share execution evidence and should not be treated as independent draws.
paragraphs.zh: 从测试集中随机抽取八篇论文进行双人交叉验证：ExactFANOVA（82 个任务）、Learning Randomized Reductions（38 个）、ATLAS（82 个）、MindOmni（53 个）、POET-X（57 个）、SlaClip（30 个）、Weak-and-Strong Verification（9 个）和 WBMM（58 个）。 审核覆盖这些论文中的全部 409 个任务在两种条件下的结果：409 个原始代码库结果和 409 个精炼产物结果，共计 818 个任务-条件结果。 审核识别出 39 个无效结果：其中 33 个来自原始代码，6 个来自精炼产物。 其余 779 个结果在本次审核中被判定为有效，包括 376 个原始代码库结果和 403 个精炼产物结果。 无效为正类，不确定的审核判定为负类。 精确率将正确的无效检测数除以所有无效预测数；召回率将正确的无效检测数除以所有经人工确认的无效结果数。 随机抽取发生在论文层面；同一论文内的任务结果可能共享执行证据，不应被视为独立抽取。

paragraphs.en: Codex misses eight of 39 human-confirmed invalid outcomes (20.5%); Claude misses 15 (38.5%). Each incorrectly flags four of 779 human-verified valid outcomes (0.5%). Codex detects a larger fraction of invalid outcomes in each condition, while Claude makes no false positive on the refined artifact subset (Table 12 ).

paragraphs.en: These cases illustrate measurement validity and evidence integrity through execution records.
paragraphs.zh: 这些案例通过执行记录说明了测量有效性与证据完整性。

paragraphs.en: For refined-artifact tasks T028, T033, and T038, execution records show epoch times of approximately 32.5, 53, and 92 seconds. Submitted JSON and local logs instead contain 206, 335, and 579 seconds, obtained by projecting subset timings to a 2,502-iteration epoch. Reviewed records show file edits 8–17 minutes after process exit and discrepancies with captured stdout. The case review notes that measured durations also satisfy the numerical intervals; the issue is reporting projections as measurements, not missing a target.
paragraphs.zh: 对于精加工产物任务 T028、T033 和 T038，执行记录显示每个 epoch 的耗时分别约为 32.5 秒、53 秒和 92 秒。 提交的 JSON 和本地日志却分别包含 206 秒、335 秒和 579 秒，这些数值是将子集耗时外推到 2,502 次迭代的 epoch 得出的。 审查记录显示，文件编辑发生在进程退出后 8–17 分钟，并且与捕获的标准输出存在差异。 案例审查指出，测得的时长同样满足数值区间；问题在于将外推值当作测量值上报，而不是未达成目标。

paragraphs.en: The Opus 5 refined-artifact Gaussian sweep for AuxiliaryMCMC ( Yuan and Wang, 2026 ) targets 100 rounds at each of three acceptance rates. Its measured workload exceeds the available clock at the chosen concurrency, and the agent executes only 55 rounds per rate. The primary audit invalidates numerical matches affected by this altered measurement procedure. Separately, one Poisson-MALA chain remains constant with zero acceptance. Its undefined effective sample size propagates through the evaluator’s ordinary mean, leaving three measurements unavailable. The Reproducer declines to redraw only the failed chain, which would select a repetition based on its outcome. Effective sample size per second also varies with host load and concurrency.
paragraphs.zh: Opus 5 精化产物的 AuxiliaryMCMC 高斯扫描（Yuan and Wang, 2026）目标是在三个接受率的每一个上进行 100 轮。 其测量的工作负载在所选并发度下超出了可用的时钟时间，智能体在每个接受率只执行了 55 轮。 初步审计判定受这一被改变的测量程序影响的数值匹配无效。 另外有一条 Poisson-MALA 链保持不变，接受率为零。 其未定义的有效样本量经由评估器的普通均值传播，导致三个测量值不可用。 复现者拒绝仅重跑失败的链，因为那样会根据结果来选择重复。 每秒有效样本量也会随主机负载和并发度而变化。

paragraphs.en: In Sonnet 5’s refined-artifact attempt on LiME ( Kowsher et al., 2026 ) , data staging and environment preparation take approximately 83 minutes, but the full schedule includes 5,949 training steps followed by evaluation over 47 splits. The attempted run’s observed throughput projects 7 to 92 wall-clock hours per variant, competing within the paper’s 24-hour allocation. Model-construction parameter counts are available before training finishes, whereas accuracy measurements require completed training and evaluation. The session reaches the former but not the latter. Across models, 13 of LiME’s 14 reversals are resource/access failures and one is a numerical mismatch.
paragraphs.zh: 在 Sonnet 5 对 LiME 的精细化制品尝试中（Kowsher et al., 2026），数据暂存与环境准备大约需要 83 分钟，但完整计划包含 5,949 个训练步骤，随后还要在 47 个数据划分上进行评估。 根据该次尝试运行观测到的吞吐量推算，每个变体需要 7 到 92 小时的实际运行时间，超出了论文设定的 24 小时时限。 模型构建的参数量在训练完成前即可获得，而准确率测量则需要训练和评估全部完成。 该会话达到了前者，但未能达到后者。 在各模型中，LiME 的 14 次反转中有 13 次是资源/访问类失败，1 次是数值不匹配。

paragraphs.en: The 84 numerical reversals span several possible mechanisms: stochastic training, timing conditions, changed execution choices, and unresolved paper–code disagreements. Construction may also introduce an incorrect setting, metric interpretation, or repair that later agents inherit. Diagnosing a particular reversal requires tracing its executed configuration and measurement procedure. The Manifold-Aware Perturbations guide, for example, flags a learning-rate discrepancy between the paper and released code for further inspection (Appendix D.5 ).
paragraphs.zh: 这 84 次数值反转涉及几种可能的机制：随机性训练、时序条件、执行选择的变更，以及论文与代码之间未解决的分歧。 构建过程也可能引入错误的设置、指标解读或修复方案，而后续的智能体会继承这些问题。 诊断某次特定的反转需要追溯其被执行的配置和测量流程。 例如，流形感知扰动指南标记了论文与已发布代码之间的一处学习率差异，以供进一步检查（附录 D.5）。

paragraphs.en: For WBMM ( Song et al., 2026 ) , the environment ablation retains experiment code and commands but removes the compatible H100 dependency route. Sonnet 5 reconstructs a Python 3.10 / PyTorch 2.0 / CUDA 11.8 stack with compatible vision libraries. A supplied binary lacks an operator’s H100 kernels, requiring a source rebuild before COCO evaluation. paragraphs.en: The released TinyImageNet loader uses ImageFolder on a validation directory containing only an images subdirectory. It therefore assigns all 10,000 validation images to one class. paragraphs.en: For four-expert settings in Mixture of Concept Bottleneck Experts ( De Santis et al., 2026 ) , the paper does not specify how multiple expression distances should be reduced, and the repository provides no Table 1 collector. The raw Sonnet 5 attempt constructs a matching between learned and reference expressions but reports the sum of tree-edit distances. For two tasks this produces 60 and 188, whereas the per-expression means are 15 and 47. The refined artifact resolves the ambiguity by documenting the denominator and implementing the corresponding collector; those downstream values are 15 and 47. The case locates the discrepancy in the underspecified reporting statistic.
paragraphs.zh: 对于概念瓶颈专家混合（Mixture of Concept Bottleneck Experts）四专家设置，论文未说明应如何对多个表达式距离进行归约，仓库也未提供对应表1的收集器。 Sonnet 5 的原始尝试在学习到的表达式与参考表达式之间构建了匹配，但报告的是树编辑距离之和。 对两个任务而言，这产生了 60 和 188，而逐表达式均值应为 15 和 47。 改进后的制品通过记录分母并实现相应的收集器来解决这一歧义；修正后的下游数值为 15 和 47。 该案例将差异定位于未明确说明的报告统计量上。

paragraphs.en: The defect occurs in examples/peft_pretraining/training_utils.py , line 222. Full batches call collate_fn , whereas the trailing partial batch is returned as a list. The evaluator calls batch.items() , so it fails when the final batch is reached. The patch changes the tail to yield collate_fn(batch) . The record traces the sole caller to validation and describes CPU checks covering empty, partial, complete, and over-full batch counts, without changing the example count. This example illustrates how a later reproducer can recover both the fix and its experimental scope.

paragraphs.en: The audit first extracts the paper-side requirement independently of the code-side inspection. This separates 44 absent-implementation records and 11 paper-silent records from the 238 in-scope findings.
